s.note: Slow-grilled hot sausage slices on toothpicks with mustard and pickled jalapeños
s.how: Grill 8 hot smoked sausages slowly over medium coals, turning often, until the skins blister and they are hot right through. Slice thickly on an angle and spear each piece with a toothpick. Serve with a bowl of yellow mustard and pickled jalapenos on the side.

s.note: Spiced beef tamales in corn husks, steamed soft, with hot sauce
s.how: Brown 400g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp cumin. Beat 300g masa harina with 100g lard, 1 tsp baking powder and 400ml warm stock to a soft dough. Spread on 16 soaked corn husks, add beef, roll up and steam 60 minutes. Serve with hot sauce.

m.note: Paprika pork rib tips glazed with tangy barbecue sauce, piled over white bread
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs cut into short pieces with smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic and salt. Cover and roast at 150C for 2.5 hours. Uncover, brush with tangy barbecue sauce and roast hot until sticky. Pile over slices of white bread with oven fries.

w.note: Spiced mashed sweet potato custard in a sweet pastry crust
w.how: Roast 800g sweet potatoes until soft, then mash with 60g butter, 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour into a blind-baked sweet shortcrust case and bake at 170C for 50 minutes until just set. Cool completely before slicing.

d.note: Fresh ginger, apple juice and lime topped with soda, bottled with a name on each. Red sign: do not drink me.
d.how: Grate a 4cm knob of ginger and squeeze the juice into a big jug through a sieve. Add 1L cloudy apple juice and the juice of 2 limes and stir. Pour into four bottles, add ice and top each with 100ml soda water. Write a name on each bottle in marker so nobody else touches it, then serve with lime wedges.
